name: Testing Strategy
description: Testing guidance centered on observable behavior, regressions, and proportionate coverage.
input_summary: A feature, bug fix, or refactoring task.
output_summary: A concise strategy for behavior-focused verification.
content: Test public behavior and failure modes at the narrowest useful boundary. Add a regression test for fixed defects, avoid coupling assertions to implementation details, and run the smallest relevant suite before the full suite.
